title: A vector template
hints: `reserve` is the heart of it: allocate raw memory, move-construct each element into the new block, destroy the old element, then free the old block. Growth is just `reserve(capacity == 0 ? 1 : capacity * 2)`.
`v.push_back(v[0])` passes a reference into the vector itself; if you grow first, that reference dangles. Copy the value before growing.
To insert in the middle, the last element has no constructed slot to move into, so construct it into the raw slot at `size()` with placement new; the others shift with ordinary move assignment.
